create.name: Sarah Noble
create.bio:
Sarah Noble is an American spiritual mentor, intuitive reader and writer who describes herself as a mystic. She came to spiritual practice through yoga during a hard period of her life, and over the years that followed she built a way of working centred on ritual, the cycles of nature and what she calls self-devotion rather than self-discipline. The warrior and huntress archetypes run through her writing, and her teaching asks students to turn inward, trust their own intuition and treat daily life as a ceremony.

Much of her one-to-one work is with the Akashic records. She offers several kinds of written soul record readings, from a short starseed reading to longer readings on soul purpose, as well as live intuitive and past-life sessions. Her online mystery school, School for the Soul, holds her courses, among them The Devotion Codes, a six-part ceremonial course shaped by the Andean medicine wheel. She also gives occasional in-person workshops, writes a weekly blog on spiritual routine and flow, and hosted a long-running podcast of solo reflections and guest conversations that reached its 268th episode in May 2026.

courses.title: The Devotion Codes
courses.description: A self-paced online course in six ceremonial parts that invites women to swap pushing and striving for steady care of themselves. It follows natural cycles and draws on the Andean medicine wheel.

courses.title: Akashic Soul Record Readings
courses.description: Written readings, sent by email, in which she consults the Akashic records about a person's soul history. Four options run from a starseed reading on soul origins to a full soul expansion reading.

courses.title: Intuitive Sessions
courses.description: Live one-to-one sessions combining oracle cards, intuition and energy work, offered as intuitive soul readings or as past-life readings.

courses.title: School for the Soul
courses.description: Her online mystery school, where her courses and mentoring for intuition, purpose and inner authority are gathered. Current students log in to work through the programmes.

courses.title: Akashic Soul Record Workshop at Bend Yoga Center
courses.description: An in-person workshop introducing the Akashic soul record and the idea of a soul's origins and purpose. Sign-up details were still to come when checked.

free_resources.title: Sarah Noble on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her free guided meditations on the Insight Timer app.

free_resources.title: Podcast with Sarah Noble
free_resources.description: An archive of 268 free episodes, mostly short solo talks on intuition, ritual and spiritual growth, with some guest conversations. It closed in May 2026 and remains on the main podcast apps and YouTube.
